\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{প্রমাণ} (prômān)}{প্রমাণ (prômān)}]{\bn{প্রমাণ} (prômān) — proof; evidence}

\label{lesson:BN-C337-proman}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to interpret, then the Bengali for briefly.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{প্রমাণ}}
\textbf{\bn{প্রমাণ}} — \emph{prômān} — \textquotedblleft{}proof; evidence\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{তোমার} \bn{কাছে} \bn{কোনো} \bn{প্রমাণ} \bn{আছে}?
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{tomār kāchhe kono prômān āchhe?}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Do you have any proof?
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{প্রমাণ}} (\emph{prômān}) is Sanskrit \emph{pramāṇa}, a measure or standard and, in logic, a proof (Monier-Williams). To have proof is -\bn{এর} \bn{কাছে} \bn{প্রমাণ} \bn{থাকা}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prômān}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prômān}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tomār kāchhe kono prômān āchhe?} — Do you have any proof?
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to interpret, then the Bengali for briefly, then say \emph{prômān} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{প্রমাণ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Proof; evidence\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{নিশ্চিত} (nishchitô)}{নিশ্চিত (nishchitô)}]{\bn{নিশ্চিত} (nishchitô) — sure; certain}

\label{lesson:BN-C337-nishchito}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for briefly, then the Bengali for proof.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{নিশ্চিত}}
\textbf{\bn{নিশ্চিত}} — \emph{nishchitô} — \textquotedblleft{}sure; certain\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমি} \bn{নিশ্চিত}, \bn{মীরা} \bn{আসবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmi nishchitô, mīrā āsbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I'm sure Mira will come.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{নিশ্চিত}} (\emph{nishchitô}) is Sanskrit \emph{niścita}, settled or ascertained (Monier-Williams). A person can be \bn{নিশ্চিত}, and so can a fact.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nishchitô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nishchitô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmi nishchitô, mīrā āsbe.} — I'm sure Mira will come.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for briefly, then the Bengali for proof, then say \emph{nishchitô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{নিশ্চিত} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Sure; certain\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ভিত্তি} (bhitti)}{ভিত্তি (bhitti)}]{\bn{ভিত্তি} (bhitti) — a basis; a foundation}

\label{lesson:BN-C337-bhitti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for proof, then the Bengali for sure.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ভিত্তি}}
\textbf{\bn{ভিত্তি}} — \emph{bhitti} — \textquotedblleft{}a basis; a foundation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{অভিযোগের} \bn{কোনো} \bn{ভিত্তি} \bn{নেই।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ei ôbhijoger kono bhitti nei.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This charge has no basis.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ভিত্তি}} (\emph{bhitti}) is Sanskrit \emph{bhitti}, a wall (Monier-Williams). The Bengali sense, the foundation or basis of a building or a claim, is not one the dictionary gives.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bhitti}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bhitti}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ei ôbhijoger kono bhitti nei.} — This charge has no basis.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for proof, then the Bengali for sure, then say \emph{bhitti} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{ভিত্তি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A basis; a foundation\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা} (shônāktô kôrā)}{শনাক্ত করা (shônāktô kôrā)}]{\bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা} (shônāktô kôrā) — to identify; to pick out}

\label{lesson:BN-C337-shonakto-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for sure, then the Bengali for a basis.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা}} — \emph{shônāktô kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to identify; to pick out\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পুলিশ} \bn{চোরকে} \bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pulish chorke shônāktô kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The police identified the thief.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{লোকটাকে} \bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini lokṭāke shônāktô kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা}} (\emph{shônāktô kôrā}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{shinākht}, recognition, with \bn{করা}: to say for certain who or what something is.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shônāktô kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shônāktô kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pulish chorke shônāktô kôrlô.} — The police identified the thief.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for sure, then the Bengali for a basis, then say \emph{shônāktô kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To identify; to pick out\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা} (udghāṭôn kôrā)}{উদ্ঘাটন করা (udghāṭôn kôrā)}]{\bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা} (udghāṭôn kôrā) — to uncover; to bring to light}

\label{lesson:BN-C337-udghaton-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a basis, then the Bengali for to identify.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা}} — \emph{udghāṭôn kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to uncover; to bring to light\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমরা} \bn{আসল} \bn{কারণ} \bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmrā āsôl kārôn udghāṭôn kôrbô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We will uncover the real reason.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{রহস্যটা} \bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini rôhôsyôṭā udghāṭôn kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা}} (\emph{udghāṭôn kôrā}) is Sanskrit \emph{udghāṭana}, an unlocking and so a laying bare (Monier-Williams), with \bn{করা}: to bring a hidden fact or a mystery into the open. \bn{রহস্য} \bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা} is to solve a mystery.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{udghāṭôn kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{udghāṭôn kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmrā āsôl kārôn udghāṭôn kôrbô.} — We will uncover the real reason.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a basis, then the Bengali for to identify, then say \emph{udghāṭôn kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Where It Came From to Show Me the Proof}

\label{lesson:BN-R337-review-330-337}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for a source and to create.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a source, to create, an influence, a reaction, an inspiration
  \item a purpose, a good turn, a profit, a financial loss, useful
  \item therefore, besides, and yet, mind you, to hold good
  \item an argument, a statement, a side in a dispute, against, to back
  \item an objection, a debate, views, to oppose, to disregard
  \item to deny, to criticise, an outlook, an example, a topic of talk
  \item importance, special, main, to interpret, briefly
  \item proof, sure, a basis, to identify, to uncover
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A source? (\textbf{\bn{উৎস}}, \emph{utsô}.) To create? (\textbf{\bn{সৃষ্টি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{srishṭi kôrā}.) An influence? (\textbf{\bn{প্রভাব}}, \emph{prôbhāb}.) A reaction? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতিক্রিয়া}}, \emph{prôtikriyā}.) An inspiration? (\textbf{\bn{প্রেরণা}}, \emph{preronā}.) A purpose? (\textbf{\bn{উদ্দেশ্য}}, \emph{uddeshyô}.) A good turn? (\textbf{\bn{উপকার}}, \emph{upôkār}.) A profit? (\textbf{\bn{লাভ}}, \emph{lābh}.) A financial loss? (\textbf{\bn{লোকসান}}, \emph{loksān}.) Useful? (\textbf{\bn{উপযোগী}}, \emph{upôjogī}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\bn{সুতরাং}}, \emph{sutôrāng}.) Besides? (\textbf{\bn{তাছাড়া}}, \emph{tāchhāṛā}.) And yet? (\textbf{\bn{অথচ}}, \emph{ôthôch}.) Mind you? (\textbf{\bn{অবশ্য}}, \emph{ôbôshyô}.) To hold good? (\textbf{\bn{খাটা}}, \emph{khāṭā}.) An argument? (\textbf{\bn{যুক্তি}}, \emph{jukti}.) A statement? (\textbf{\bn{বক্তব্য}}, \emph{bôktôbyô}.) A side in a dispute? (\textbf{\bn{পক্ষ}}, \emph{pôkkhô}.) Against? (\textbf{\bn{বিরুদ্ধে}}, \emph{biruddhe}.) To back? (\textbf{\bn{সমর্থন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{sômôrthôn kôrā}.) An objection? (\textbf{\bn{আপত্তি}}, \emph{āpôtti}.) A debate? (\textbf{\bn{বিতর্ক}}, \emph{bitôrkô}.) Views? (\textbf{\bn{মতামত}}, \emph{môtāmôt}.) To oppose? (\textbf{\bn{বিরোধিতা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{birodhitā kôrā}.) To disregard? (\textbf{\bn{উপেক্ষা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{upekkhā kôrā}.) To deny? (\textbf{\bn{অস্বীকার} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ôsvīkār kôrā}.) To criticise? (\textbf{\bn{সমালোচনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{sômālochônā kôrā}.) An outlook? (\textbf{\bn{দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি}}, \emph{drishṭibhônggi}.) An example? (\textbf{\bn{উদাহরণ}}, \emph{udāhôrôn}.) A topic of talk? (\textbf{\bn{প্রসঙ্গ}}, \emph{prôsônggô}.) Importance? (\textbf{\bn{গুরুত্ব}}, \emph{gurutvô}.) Special? (\textbf{\bn{বিশেষ}}, \emph{bishesh}.) Main? (\textbf{\bn{মূল}}, \emph{mūl}.) To interpret? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যাখ্যা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bækhyā kôrā}.) Briefly? (\textbf{\bn{সংক্ষেপে}}, \emph{sôngkkhepe}.) Proof? (\textbf{\bn{প্রমাণ}}, \emph{prômān}.) Sure? (\textbf{\bn{নিশ্চিত}}, \emph{nishchitô}.) A basis? (\textbf{\bn{ভিত্তি}}, \emph{bhitti}.) To identify? (\textbf{\bn{শনাক্ত} \bn{করা}}, \emph{shônāktô kôrā}.) To uncover? (\textbf{\bn{উদ্ঘাটন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{udghāṭôn kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
